summary.headline: PNGS Reva Q1 FY27 revenue rose 119.5% YoY to INR118 crore, with PAT of INR27.21 crore (23.06% margin) and EBITDA margin of 28.76%.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations reached INR118 crore, up 119.5% YoY, driven mainly by diamond caratage volumes, which management said rose more than 50% in quarter. Gross profit was INR41.83 crore (35.46% margin), EBITDA INR33.92 crore (28.76%), and PAT INR27.21 crore (23.06%). Management attributed margin strength to scale and better caratage-based diamond realisations, while flagging that marketing spend, deliberately deferred to Q2-Q4, will dent PAT by 1-2% per quarter for the rest of the year. Network reached 37 stores (3 COCO, 34 SIS) after a Pune COCO opening on 7 July 2026.

financial_highlights.change: vs INR112,000 in Q4 FY26 per management
up from about INR30 lakh, due to interest on parked IPO proceeds

financial_highlights.value: INR27 million, of which INR26.53 million is interest and INR0.95 million is lease liability interest

segments.name: Diamond jewellery (core)
segments.commentary: Growth driven by volume: diamond caratage up more than 50% YoY in the quarter, with ~97% of business in small diamonds (star melee / minus-two). Average order value about INR1 lakh.

segments.name: COCO stores
segments.commentary: 3 COCO stores in operation (Amanora Mall Pune opened 7 July 2026); management says none is over a year old, so no SSSG reported. Two of the planned 15 COCO stores are already operational.

segments.name: SIS (shop-in-shop with PNGS)
segments.commentary: 34 SIS stores; management reported about 50% SSSG across SIS stores and growth across all ~21 cities served. SIS is about 95% of revenue today.

guidance_outlook: FY28 margin view: full-year EBITDA margin expected at 25-27% and PAT margin at 22-23%, after a 2-3 percentage point dent from marketing in Q2-Q4.
Management clarified the 200-300 bps full-year margin impact is mainly marketing-led, not EBO fixed costs; EBO impact is considered immaterial as most open in H2.
Store plan: 9 COCO stores in year one and 7 in year two post IPO, all COCO (no franchise). Breakeven: Maharashtra EBOs in about one year; outside Maharashtra 15-18 months.
Inventory turns expected between 1.1x and 1.4x; management said a 0.75x breakeven and 1.25-1.5x for meaningful profit.
Q1 typically ~15% of annual revenue; H1 ~35% and H2 ~65%. Q2 expected better than Q1.
Guidance unchanged, per Aditya Modak; management says it is more confident in delivering prior commitments.
E-commerce website to launch by end of August 2026.
Short-term WCDL of ~INR166 crore at FY26 end, reduced to about INR120 crore; repayment to continue from profits, with EBO expansion to be funded mainly from internal accruals and IPO proceeds.
capex_capacity: Store network at 37 (3 COCO, 34 SIS) after Amanora Mall Pune COCO opened 7 July 2026.
Plan to open 15 COCO stores from IPO proceeds: 9 in the first year, 7 in the second; 2 already operational.
Store selection uses multi-level approvals, market assessment and feasibility studies; management emphasises payback over speed of rollout.
Gold loan limit available from bank but not yet used; plan to draw in coming quarters.
demand_pricing: Demand strong across ~21 cities; management said growth was broad-based, not concentrated in Pune.
Akshaya Tritiya revenue INR12.7 crore, up 268% YoY; monsoon season also contributed in June.

Management views gold price correction as supportive for wedding and festive buying; said diamond jewellery is utility-based and less affected by the government's request to slow gold buying than plain gold.
Lab-grown competition: management says price gap for small diamonds is only 10-15% on a product basis and it is not feeling material pressure.
Marketing spend was modest in Q1 and is to be deployed in Q2-Q4; a brand ambassador is under negotiation with none signed yet.

qa_highlights.question: Are EBITDA and PAT margins sustainable, and what drove them?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited scale (turnover roughly doubled) and better caratage-based diamond realisation. Full-year EBITDA expected at 25-27% and PAT at 22-23% after marketing dent.

qa_highlights.question: Volume growth in June/July and outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Diamond caratage volume up more than 50% in Q1; July not closed, so no figure given.

qa_highlights.question: Hedging approach for gold inventory?
qa_highlights.answer: No MCX hedging; relies on natural hedge from periodic gold buying and selling. Gold loan limit available but unused as gold share of inventory is small.

qa_highlights.question: SSSG split between COCO and SIS?
qa_highlights.answer: No COCO SSSG as stores are under one year old; SIS SSSG about 50%.

qa_highlights.question: Any upward guidance revision after Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: No change in guidance; management says it is more confident in delivering it.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of government request to slow gold buying?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said plain gold was hit more; the company saw no impact, with optimism from customers over the last two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Trade payables fell from INR32 crore to INR20 crore; why?
qa_highlights.answer: Timing of payments, with no change in vendor credit terms, per management.

qa_highlights.question: Average order value trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 FY26 about INR112,000 and Q1 FY27 about INR1 lakh; seasonal, with Q2 and Q3 expected higher on festive demand.

risks_watch: Marketing spend ramp in Q2-Q4 will reduce PAT margin by roughly 2-3 percentage points versus Q1 levels.
Inventory turns could fall as COCO stores are added; management expects 1.1-1.4x.
EBO breakeven timelines (one year in Maharashtra, 15-18 months outside) are unproven; only three EBOs are open, one for over six months.
Short-term debt of about INR120 crore outstanding; repayment depends on profit realisation.
Management health: Amit Modak (CEO) was unwell and did not continue the call; the company's sister listed entity PNGS Gargi reportedly slowed sharply in the quarter.
Trade payables fell sharply; management attributed this to payment timing, which should be verified next quarter.
summary.management_tone: Confident on top-line momentum and demand, but cautious and vague on forward specifics: several answers were deferred or unconfirmed (finance cost split, July volumes, brand ambassador, store timelines). The CEO was unwell and spoke only briefly.
